mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals strong consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies benefit from increased sales and profitability.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of RSAFS growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO decreases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% in a month, it signals a strengthening housing market, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate increased economic activity and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between HOUST increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month, it signals strong labor market conditions, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased consumer spending and economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between PAYEMS increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure during a period of high interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings and economic growth.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.3% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary period with high interest rates
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect between high FEDFUNDS and increasing CPIAUCSL on negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) increases by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals strong economic growth and improving labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate increased corporate earnings and economic activity.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 2% QoQ and UNRATE decrease > 0.3% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction effect between increasing GDPC1 and decreasing UNRATE on positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
